fields.description: The connected WhatsApp instance used to send this campaign. Defaults to your own instance if left empty.
fields.label: Send From Instance

fields.description: Minimum delay in seconds between messages (random delay used)
fields.label: Min Delay (seconds)

fields.description: Maximum delay in seconds between messages (random delay used)
fields.label: Max Delay (seconds)

fields.description: Send in limited batches with cool-down hours to protect the number from getting banned.
fields.label: Enable Batch Sending (Anti-Ban)

fields.description: Number of messages to send per batch/day before cooling down (e.g. 20)
fields.label: Batch Size (Messages)

fields.description: Cool-down hours to pause after reaching batch size before starting the next batch (e.g. 24 or 48 hours)
fields.label: Wait Between Batches (Hours)

fields.description: Gradually increase batch size after several successful batches to safely warm up the number.
fields.label: Enable Gradual Warm-up

fields.description: Number of batches to complete before increasing the batch size (e.g. every 2 batches)
fields.label: Increase Every (Batches)

fields.description: How many messages to add to the batch size on each increase step (e.g. +10)
fields.label: Increase Batch Size By

fields.description: Maximum batch size ceiling (e.g. max 50 messages/day)
fields.label: Max Batch Size Ceiling

fields.description: When the next batch is scheduled to resume automatically.
fields.label: Next Batch Scheduled Time

fields.description: Turn on to send approved WhatsApp Templates. Turn off to send plain Message Content.
fields.label: Use Template

fields.description: Choose whether to use one template, rotate multiple templates among recipients, or use a custom template per recipient.
fields.label: Template Mode
fields.options:
Single Template
Rotate Multiple Templates
Per Recipient

fields.description: The WhatsApp Template used as the campaign message.
fields.label: Template

fields.description: List of templates to rotate among recipients (recipient 1 gets template 1, recipient 2 gets template 2, etc.) to prevent spam pattern detection.
fields.label: Rotating Templates

fields.description: How template placeholders ({{1}}, {{2}}...) are filled. Common: same values for all recipients. Unique: different values taken from each recipient data.
fields.label: Variable Type

fields.description: Shared values for the template placeholders, as JSON. Example: {"1": "Mubtkir", "2": "20% off"}
fields.label: Template Variables

fields.description: Plain text body. Supports Spintax {Option 1|Option 2|Option 3} and placeholders {name}, {mobile}.
fields.label: Message Content

fields.description: Optional image (PNG, JPG, WEBP), PDF, video or audio. When using Evolution API, images are sent directly to WhatsApp with your message text as a caption.
fields.label: Attach Image / Media
Status
fields.options:
Draft
Queued
In Progress
Completed
Partially Failed
Failed

fields.description: Number of successfully accepted messages, not total attempts.
fields.label: Sent Count

fields.description: Per-recipient diagnostics: endpoint, HTTP status and the raw Evolution response. Use it to trace why a message did not arrive.
fields.label: Send Log

fields.description: Leave empty to queue immediately after submission. Future times are picked up automatically by the scheduler.
fields.label: Scheduled Time
